metadata.title: Verify CI Pipeline
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Check CI/CD pipeline status after git push. Loads pipeline configuration from .ai/deploy-config.json (with auto-discovery fallback). If the pipeline fails, extract failure details and loop back to the implementation step for targeted fixes. Supports configurable max retries.

output.description: CI pipeline status — passed confirmation or failure details with fix context

prerequisites: Prepare for Review step completed (code committed and pushed)
Git remote and CI pipeline configured for the repository

configSchema.description: Per-repo pipeline configuration. Holds CI (build) settings. CD (deployment/release) settings are defined in the cd section and consumed by the deploy-to-testing sub-process.

structure.ado_project: ADO project name (e.g. 'Payoneer') — shared across CI and CD

ci.pipeline_definition_id: CI/build pipeline definition ID to monitor
ci.timeout_minutes: Max minutes to wait for pipeline completion (default: 15)

specificActions: If config missing or incomplete: auto-discover from ADO and present to user for approval
Use config to identify the correct CI pipeline definition
Check pipeline status — poll if still running using config timeout/interval
If pipeline passed → proceed to next step
If pipeline failed → extract failure logs, error messages, and failing tests
Track retry iteration count and respect maxIterations from template
If failed and retries < max: store failure context in memory and signal loop-back
If failed and retries >= max: log warning about unresolved CI failure, proceed
When looping back, failure details must be stored in memory so the implementation step can target the fix
tools: mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_definition - Auto-discover pipeline definitions for the repo
mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_build_log - Read build logs on failure
bestPractices: Always try to load config from file first — only auto-discover if missing
When auto-discovering, present findings to user for confirmation before using them
Wait for the pipeline to complete before checking — don't check prematurely
Extract the most relevant failure information: failing step, error message, failing test names
Provide actionable context for the implementation step to fix the issue
Distinguish between infrastructure failures (retry-worthy) and code failures (fix-worthy)
When retry cap is reached, clearly document what's still failing

substeps.name: Load Deploy Config
actions: Check if .ai/deploy-config.json exists in the repo root
If exists: read and parse JSON, extract ado_project and ci.* fields
Validate required fields: ado_project and ci.pipeline_definition_id
If config missing or has null required fields: auto-discover from ADO
Auto-discovery: parse git remote for project/repo, list pipeline definitions via mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_definition, match by repo name
Present discovered values to user for confirmation before proceeding
Store resolved config in memory as deployConfig
Determine current retry iteration (check ciRetryIteration in memory)

substeps.name: Identify CI pipeline run
substeps.description: Find the pipeline run triggered by the recent push
actions: Using deployConfig.ci.pipeline_definition_id, query for recent builds on the current branch
Find the build triggered by the most recent push
If no build found, check if the pipeline is configured to trigger on this branch

substeps.name: Wait for pipeline completion
actions: Check pipeline run status
If still running, poll at intervals (deployConfig.ci.poll_interval_seconds, default 30s)
Respect timeout (deployConfig.ci.timeout_minutes, default 15min)
Wait until pipeline reaches a terminal state (succeeded, failed, canceled) or timeout

substeps.name: Evaluate pipeline result
substeps.description: Check if pipeline passed or failed
actions: If succeeded → record success, proceed
If failed → extract build logs and error details
If canceled → treat as failure, note cancellation
Categorize failure: build error, test failure, infrastructure issue, timeout

substeps.name: Extract failure context
substeps.description: Gather actionable details for the implementation step
actions: Only execute if pipeline failed
Read build logs from the failing stage/task via mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_build_log
Extract: error messages, failing test names, stack traces
Summarize what needs to be fixed in a format the implementation step can act on

substeps.name: Make retry decision
substeps.description: Decide whether to loop back or proceed
actions: If pipeline passed → proceed to next step
If pipeline failed AND retries < maxIterations → store failure context in memory, signal loop-back to Execute Implementation
If pipeline failed AND retries >= maxIterations → log warning about unresolved CI failure, proceed to next step
Record ciRetryIteration, ciPipelineStatus, ciFailureDetails, and ciDecision in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Load deploy config (.ai/deploy-config.json or auto-discover) → Identify pipeline run → Wait for completion → Evaluate result → Extract failure context (if failed) → Retry decision (loop back or proceed)

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Prepare for Review results (commits pushed), .ai/deploy-config.json, previous CI retry iterations
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: Deploy config and CI verification results
fields: Information Produced: deployConfig (ado_project, ci.*), ciPipelineStatus (passed/failed/canceled), ciFailureDetails (error messages, failing tests), ciRetryIteration (current retry number), ciDecision (passed/retry/cap-reached)
Decisions Made: Config source (file vs auto-discovered), retry or proceed decision with justification
